description: This file defines the BookDAO class, which provides data access methods for managing books in a library management system, including CRUD operations, reservations, and searches.

classes.name: BookDAO
classes.description: Data Access Object class for performing database operations related to books in the library system.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the BookDAO with a database connection object.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes a book record by ID.

methods.name: reserve
methods.description: Reserves a book for a user if available, updating the database accordingly.

methods.name: getBooksByUser
methods.description: Retrieves all books reserved by a specific user.

methods.name: getBooksCountByUser
methods.description: Counts the number of books reserved by a specific user.

methods.name: getBook
methods.description: Fetches details of a specific book by ID.

methods.name: available
methods.description: Checks if a book is available based on its count.

methods.name: getById
methods.description: Retrieves a book record by ID.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Lists all books, optionally filtering by availability.

methods.name: getReserverdBooksByUser
methods.description: Gets a concatenated list of book IDs reserved by a user.

methods.name: search_book
methods.description: Searches for books by name with optional availability filter.
